description: Full details for one entry: raw server.json, install snippets for the runtime, lookupd metadata. Pass the registry name (e.g. io.github.acme/linear-mcp), or, for a server already in your MCP config, its remote url or its npm/PyPI package; that finds the registry name to use with report_outcome. When several entries launch the same url or package, `matches` lists them all, most likely first.

domain.description: What the conversation is about, from the fixed list

package.description: npm or PyPI package from the MCP config, e.g. @acme/pdf-mcp

session.description: A random id you make up once per conversation (8-64 letters, digits, _ or -; never derived from the user, project or machine) and repeat on every lookupd call in it, report_outcome included

url.description: Remote URL from the MCP config

name: get_entry
title: Get an entry
